title: Host sees two metallic orbs during holotropic breathwork

tellings.quote: have an experience like that where I was doing holotropic breath work with a friend in Silver Lake, California of all places

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says he saw two metallic orbs while doing holotropic breathwork, a practice of deep, rapid breathing meant to bring on altered states, with a friend in Silver Lake, a neighbourhood of Los Angeles, California. He brings it up while talking with a man said to attract UFOs, as a sign that such sightings might be linked to the state of a person's mind.
